paper_metadata.title: Achieving ultrahigh strength in CoCrNi-based medium-entropy alloys with synergistic strengthening effect

evidence.quote: Here, we report a novel CoCrNiAl0.1Mo0.1 medium-entropy alloy, which possessed a complex structure comprising with the non-recrystallized structure, recrystallized structure, fine grains and precipitate phase.

evidence.quote: These specimens were cut into cubes with 20 mm (length) x 10 mm (width) x 10 mm (thickness) by electrical discharge machining (EDM) before the ingots were homogenized in vacuum for 2 h at 1200 °C
and then cold-rolled to 2 mm in thickness reduction of 80%.
The rolled specimens were annealed at 725, 750, 800 and 900 °C for 1 h in air, and then underwent water cooling.

evidence.quote: The non-recrystallized region shows the high density dislocation walls and large numbers of fine dislocation cells ( Fig. 1 b).
